description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension with elevational alterations to the existing extension of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (117-P-028 Rev A, 117-P-027, 117-P-026 Rev A, 117-P-024, 117-P-022 Rev A, 117-P-020 Rev C, 117-E-018, 117-E-017, 117-E-016, 117-E-015 Rev A, 117-E-014, 117-E-013, 117-E-012, 117-E-010 Rev A, 117-E-002, 1:1250 site location plan, Design and Access Statement dated May 2019. Received: 31st May 2019 117-P-025 Rev A. Received: 28th August 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The proposed window to the southern elevation of the existing outrigger shall be obscurely glazed and fixed shut and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development.
